dog.description_text:
Please note: Any profiles with a "Pawling, NY" icon are located at the ASPCA Recovery & Rehabilitation Center, which is a 90-minute drive outside of the city. All other dogs are located in New York City.

Meet Daiquiri, a handsome guy who knows how to turn on the charm!

With his bright blue eyes and unique coat, Daiquiri is sure to catch your attention, but his affectionate personality is what makes him special. He loves a good head massage and has a habit of melting right into his favorite people for some extra love! Daiquiri also enjoys showing off his tricks, especially when tasty treats are involved. When he’s ready to relax, he’s happy to settle in with a bully stick and enjoy some quiet time.

Want to win Daiquiri’s heart? A little patience, plenty of love and some chicken are great places to start! Click the “Adopt Me” button to connect with Daiquiri’s team in Pawling, New York!

*We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: DAIQUIRI
